map.可复现算例：一节团体课的质量评估: Reproducible worked example: quality assessment of one group class
map.四个维度的权重为什么是 25/25/20/30？: Why are the four dimension weights 25/25/20/30?
map.学员效果权重最高（30%），因为课程最终要落到留存与满意度；师资与课程内容各 2: Student outcome carries the highest weight (30%), because the course ultimately lands on retention and satisfaction; teaching staff and course content at 25% each are the direct source of quality; the learning environment at 20% is a necessary condition but relatively easy to change. Weights can be replaced proportionally when the assessment criteria are adjusted.
map.师资力量 = 认证系数×0.6 + min(从业年限/10, 1)×4（上限 1: Teaching strength = accreditation factor x 0.6 + min(years of experience / 10, 1) x 4 (capped at 10); course content = mean of the three scores; learning environment = temperature x 0.3 + humidity x 0.2 + class size x 0.25 + area per person x 0.25 (10 when all thresholds are met, 5-6 when not); student outcome = (satisfaction x 0.3 + retention x 0.3 + renewal x 0.2 + progress x 0.2) / 10. Grades: 8.5 and above is excellent S, 7.5 and above good A, 6.0 and above satisfactory B, 4.5 and above pass C, anything else is fail D; any single item below 7 is marked "needs improvement".
map.教练自评或在评课时定位短板：任意维度低于 7 分即判「待提升」并自动列出改进项，: For coach self-assessment or locating weaknesses during lesson observation: any dimension below 7 is marked "needs improvement" and improvement items are listed automatically, so you do not fixate on the total score and miss structural problems.
map.环境合规复核：室温、湿度、班级人数、人均面积四项按阈值判定 ✓/✗，作为场馆择址: Environmental compliance re-check: temperature, humidity, class size and area per person are each judged against thresholds as pass or fail, serving as a hard criterion for venue siting or class scheduling.
map.瑜伽馆或工作室做季度课程质量体检：从师资、课程内容、教学环境、学员效果四个维度打: A yoga studio or workshop runs a quarterly course quality check: score teaching staff, course content, learning environment and student outcome across four dimensions to produce a comparable overall score and grade.
map.综合评分 = 师资×0.25 + 课程内容×0.25 + 教学环境×0.20 +: Overall score = teaching staff x 0.25 + course content x 0.25 + learning environment x 0.20 + student outcome x 0.30
map.页面用 toFixed(1) 保留一位小数，而 6.85 在二进制浮点中略小于: The page uses toFixed(1) to keep one decimal place, and 6.85 is slightly below 6.85 in binary floating point, so it displays as 6.8 after rounding. This is a rounding boundary artefact and does not affect the grade (6.0 <= 6.85 < 7.5 is a good B grade).
